'''Saban 2 (February 17)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Merilille Ceandevin|Merilille]] is sent to [[Braem Wood]] to contact the [[Borderlands|Borderland]] rulers situated there.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Rand]] and [[Min]] arrive in [[Caemlyn]]. [[Nynaeve]] agrees to help Rand cleanse ''[[saidin]]''.
*[[1000 NE]] - Rand is bonded to [[Aviendha]], [[Elayne]], and Min.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Tuon]] arrives in [[Ebou Dar]] from [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Valan Luca]] agrees to let [[Mat]] travel out of Ebou Dar with him. Mat is then attacked by a [[gholam]] and rescued by [[Noal Charin]].
